'''Kamil''' is a boss that can be encountered in the [[Nightmare Zone]]. He is a version of the regular [[Kamil]] encountered in the [[Desert Treasure I]] quest.

[[Fire spells]] are not required to damage him, and your stats will not be drained like in the [[Ice path]]. He frequently uses freezes, interrupting movement and auto-retaliate. He is immune to movement inhibitors from [[ice spell]]s, [[bind]], [[snare]], and [[entangle]], and is capable of teleporting short distances around the player.

In Endurance mode, 4,830 reward points are earned upon defeating the normal difficulty version, and 17,032 reward points are earned upon defeating the hard difficulty version.
